verdict.rationale: Reader offers a headless Chrome fetching engine (`x-engine: browser`). Its hosted proxy pool (`x-proxy: auto`, API key required) rotates residential and datacenter IPs and 'handles common anti-bot challenges automatically.' That is anti-bot help through proxying, not a documented undetected or stealth browser mode, and the claim covers only 'common' challenges rather than sophisticated detection. Missing for 10: an explicit undetected/stealth browser mode (e.g. fingerprint evasion), evidence of beating sophisticated bot-detection systems, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
